columns.name: Action
columns.description: The action completed by the event: Registered, Updated, or Deleted.

columns.name: ClientId
columns.description: Unique customer facing identifier assigned by the platform when the LTI tool is registered.

columns.name: ToolName
columns.description: The name of the external learning tool.

columns.name: Domain
columns.description: Domain for the registered tool.

columns.name: RedirectURLs
columns.description: List of Redirect URLs provided by the tool, formatted as comma-separated values (CSV) list. The list is truncated to the max length allowed in the BDS field.

columns.name: KeysetURL
columns.description: The Keyset URL needed to complete the launch. The value is truncated to the max length allowed in the BDS field. Field can be null.

columns.name: LoginURL
columns.description: The Initial LTI login request endpoint as by the tool. The value is truncated to the max length allowed in the BDS field.

columns.name: LTIVersion
columns.description: Indicates whether the registration is for LTI 1.1 or LTI 1.3.

columns.name: IsRegistrationEnabled
columns.description: If true, the tool registration is enabled for the organization.

columns.name: SendInstitutionRole
columns.description: If true, the registration includes both contextual and institutional roles. If false, the registration only includes contextual roles.

columns.name: TargetLinkURI
columns.description: Optional Target Link URI used during the Deep Linking workflow when the tool doesn't provide a launch URL for the returned LTI Resource Link. Field can be null.

columns.name: ModifiedBy
columns.description: The ID of the Brightspace user that updated the tool registration data.

columns.name: HasAssignmentAndGradeServices
columns.description: If true, the Assignments and grades services (AGS) extension is enabled for this registration.

columns.name: HasSubmissionReview
columns.description: If true, the Submission Review extension is enabled for this registration.

columns.name: HasDeepLinking
columns.description: If true, the Deep Linking extension is enabled for this registration.

columns.name: HasNamesAndRoleProvisioningServices
columns.description: If true, the Names and Roles Provisioning Services (NRPS) extension is enabled for this registration.

columns.name: HasActivityItemProfile
columns.description: If true, the Activity Item Profile extension is enabled for this registration.

columns.name: HasPlatformNotificationService
columns.description: If true, the Platform Notification Service is enabled for this registration.

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.description: Date and time (UTC) when the user created or modified the registration.

columns.name: HasAssetProcessor
columns.description: If true, the Asset Processor Services are enabled for this registration. The Platform Notification Service and Deeplinking must also be enabled.
